top_50.generated_answer:
- Plyometrics: box jumps, depth jumps, lateral bounds, jump rope to boost vertical and first-step explosiveness.
- Agility and footwork (use the cones at your new gym): zig-zag change-of-direction, defensive slide shuttles, closeout → turn-and-sprint, ladder drills.
- Game-paced conditioning: suicides, 17s, 30:30 or 15:15 shuttle runs, slide–sprint circuits; on low-impact days, bike or rower intervals.
- Core and single‑leg stability: Pallof presses/holds, planks, Copenhagen planks, single‑leg RDLs, split squats, hop‑to‑stick landing drills.
- Mobility/prehab: ankle dorsiflexion work, hip flexor and glute mobility, T‑spine rotations, calf raises, banded shoulder external rotations, mini‑band lateral walks.
- Skill reps to match your shooting focus: form shooting/Mikan, spot-up into off‑the‑dribble progressions, free‑throw routines; ball‑handling with two balls, cone dribble combos, pick‑and‑roll reads.

Coordinate these with your daily PT so progressions fit your current rehab and practice load.
